reviews.text: Ryan communicates every week to confirm the schedules and walkers, and the walkers communicate each day to let me know that the walk is complete and how my dog did.  I recently had my dog at a friend’s place while out of town and Ryan was happily able to assist at the other address.  I always feel very comfortable knowing that my dog will be well cared for.  I would highly recommend!

Really amazing dog walking service. Very flexible and convenient. The owners are very caring and dedicated to ensure a great walking experience. Our dog gets nervous and they do a great job of working with him. Highly recommend!

Millennium Dog Walkers are truly the best in the business! They are professional, always eager to assist you with any needs, and treat your pet like their own! Ryan and his team are stellar! I recently moved to the city and work crazy hours as a resident. I was so nervous trying to find people that would help take care of my golden! Ryan connected with me just hours after sending in my inquiry and was so comprehensive in the meet and greet process! My Lincoln loves his walker Rebecca! She is reliable and always sends prompt updates with pictures! I can relax easy knowing my pup is in great hands! I highly recommend Millennium Dog Walkers! They are life savers for pet parents!!

Since I was introduced to Ryan, the owner, I’ve finally had complete peace of mind when it comes to my two mini dachshunds. I had an okay experience with another company before, but compared to what I have now, it’s truly night and day.

My pups absolutely love when Chris comes to visit them for their 30-minute midday walk. She is always on time, sends me pictures, makes sure they have fresh water, and, most importantly, gives them plenty of attention and snuggles. ❤️

The entire team is wonderful. Scheduling is extremely organized, communication is easy, and the whole process has been incredibly smooth and reliable. On the days I’m in the office, I never have to worry because I know my girls are being well taken care of.

Thank you, Ryan, Chris, and the entire team for taking such great care of my pups! I’m so happy I found you and look forward to continuing to work with you. Highly recommend!

Truly the best of the best! I moved to Chicago and was so worried about finding someone reliable to walk my dog Dot every day and they have exceeded expectations! Caroline and Ryan both run the company with amazing communication, are super personable with each of their customers, and genuinely care!! Patricia, who walks my dog, she is truly the BEST. I can leave each day not being worried about Dot because I know how much she loves Patricia! I trust her so much and am truly so very grateful for her!!

I’ve been very pleased with the service. The onboarding process was easy and well organized, and our walker has been dependable, communicative, and genuinely caring with Macey. I really appreciate the updates after each walk, and my day is much better knowing that Macey is getting a good walk and attention while I’m not home. I highly recommend them!

Moving to the city and trusting someone to come into your home to care for your dog can be so nerve-racking, especially when you’re as picky as I am about my pup! From the very beginning, Ryan has been incredibly easy to communicate with and made the entire process stress-free.

Patricia and Nicole have been absolutely amazing with Cooper. They’re professional, reliable, and always send me pictures and updates, which gives me so much peace of mind. Cooper absolutely loves them, and it’s obvious they genuinely care about the dogs they work with.

This team has exceeded every expectation I had. They’re so easy to work with, dependable, and kind. I truly cannot recommend them enough. If you’re looking for a dog walker in the area, this is the team to trust. I will forever recommend them!

Millennium Dog Walkers has been everything we hoped they would be since we moved to Chicago. When we first moved to Streeterville, we used Rover for a few months with really mixed results. Then we found Millennium Dog Walkers and they have been the absolute sweetest with our two dogs. They now help us with midday walks when we’re out of the apartment working, and they give 3-long-walks a day on weekends if we’re out of town, allowing our dogs to stay in their home but get tons of love while we’re gone.

They’ve gone above and beyond so many times now I’ve lost count. From picking up medications needed for our dogs to last minute walks while we have to leave town on an urgent trip. We’ve since moved up to Roscoe Village and they still walk our dogs just as much as when we were closer to downtown. If you’re looking for a true partner, Ryan and Caroline are it. Incredibly thankful we found them when we moved here!

After several disappointing experiences with previous dog walkers, finding Millennium Dog Walkers was an incredible relief. From the very beginning, their professionalism and level of care stood out. The owners personally came to our home, took the time to understand our concerns, and immediately made us feel completely comfortable entrusting them with our dog.

Our dog has a chronic health condition, is not spayed, and can be very shy with new people, so choosing the right dog walker was not something we took lightly. She requires patience, attentiveness, and careful adherence to specific instructions. Millennium Dog Walkers listened closely to every detail and consistently provided the thoughtful, individualized care she needed. Their approach never felt rushed or impersonal.

Their communication is exceptional. We receive detailed updates and photos after each walk, and our dog always looks calm, content, and genuinely happy. It is evident that they do not simply walk dogs—they build trust with them and care for them as individuals.

Millennium Dog Walkers are dependable, respectful, highly professional, and truly compassionate. I would recommend them without hesitation, particularly to anyone who is selective about who they trust with their dog or has a pet with medical, behavioral, or highly specific needs. The peace of mind they provide is invaluable, and we feel incredibly fortunate to have found them.

My husband and I started using Millennium Dog Walkers when I moved back to Day shift about a year ago. As healthcare workers we need the flexibility which they have always provided. Most daycares for dogs open at 7 and close at 7, which are prime working hours for the both of us which led us to find a dog walker!  We are able to schedule our walks the week before, make changes as things come up, and even cancel if one of us is going to make it home on time. Every dog walker and individual we have worked with is AMAZING. They take the time to come meet our dog, Tito, to help relieve some of his anxiety and timidness. We get a picture and update with every walk which also helps relieve us knowing he isn’t just sitting at home. We appreciate everyone at Millennium Dog Walkers and just know your dog is safe with them!
I’ve used them twice for over night stays with dog walking.  They did a wonderful job. Communication is great before, during, and after the job.  Many thanks!!!

The MDW Team has been a great help with our dog, Tito… they are very flexible with our hectic schedules and great communicators when it comes to scheduling and updates on the walks. They are also more than willing to do weekend walks when needed. Highly recommend using their services!

I started using Millenium Dog Walker when I was in need of a dog walker after I had just moved. No dog walkers were available in my area, but that’s when Ryan stepped in and paired me with my now dog walker, Kyle. Both are a god send! My girl, Dulce, is a little wary of men and new people. It’s in the chow chow in her. However, after a few walks, she started to warm up to Kyle. He sends me photos everyday, with an update of how their walk went. It makes me feel at peace knowing she’s being taken care of when I’m not around. Thank you Millenium Dog Walker!

This is the best dog walking service in Chicago! They are reliable, dependable and always on time! Our dog absolutely loves their walkers and they give the best updates on how their walk went with pictures. Highly recommend!

My wife and I have been through six different local dog walking agencies — please listen to me when I say that Millenium has been HANDS DOWN the best one to work with. Kyle is punctual and polite. Whenever anything requires my attention - whether my dog Ralphie had extra food at lunch, took an extra bathroom break, or made a new friend on their walk - Kyle was sure to communicate with me in a thorough manner. The owners, Ryan and Caroline, onboarded me thoroughly and made sure I was matched with the right walker; and they nailed it.

Ryan and his team at Millennium Dog Walkers are as good as they get. They are communicative, trustworthy, punctual and professional. My Newfoundland Mowgli loves his walker Rebecca and so do we. Having peace of mind with a good dog walker coming into your home and taking care of your pet is priceless! This team has my stamp of approve and will use them as long as I am in Chicago.
Very personable staff and exceptional care for our pups!  It was important for us to find someone who could handle our senior dog who needed patience and assistance.

I absolutely recommend Millennium Dog Walkers! This was my first time using a dog walker and my dog can sometimes get nervous around new people, but they were amazing with him from the start and did such a great job of making him feel comfortable. He now gets SO excited for his walks with them. Their communication was perfect the entire time, and I love getting the pictures and updates on how the walks went. I could not have asked for a better experience, 10/10!
Had a great experience!

We were so fortunate to find the great people at Millennium Dog Walkers! We always know our best friends will be in great hands with anyone the team sends our way! Aniya has been very good to our dogs making sure they are set up for success for their days at home! The team communicated perfectly to ensure our expectations were met. Reach out to Ryan, Caroline and the rest of the wonderful team at Millennium, and I can guarantee your pets will feel loved and at home :)
They take care of my furbaby every time! They send updates which I love! I trust them every time I use them especially going out of town! Definitely recommend!!

I can’t recommend Millennial Walks enough! They are absolutely fantastic, super reliable and incredibly communicative, which gives me so much peace of mind. My puppies absolutely love them, and that says everything.

If you’re looking for a dog walker, I have to give a special shoutout to Caroline. She is truly the best. She is so sweet and patient with my dogs, especially since my chihuahua has anxiety and my bigger dog has a lot of energy. She always goes above and beyond to make them feel comfortable and cared for.

One of my favorite things is the amazing photos she sends during their walks. They seriously make my day every time. Knowing my dogs are in such caring and attentive hands twice a week means everything.

You’d be lucky to have Caroline and the Millennial Walks team!

Rebecca has been wonderful with our dog, Sophie. Sophie is always so excited to see her, which says a lot about how comfortable and cared for she feels. Rebecca consistently sends photos and updates after each walk, which I really appreciate because it keeps me informed about how everything went.

She has also been incredibly attentive—when Sophie was having some stomach issues, Rebecca made sure to let me know right away so we could monitor things and determine if a vet visit might be needed. That level of care and communication means a lot as a pet owner.

Overall, she is extremely professional, reliable, and clearly loves what she does. I would absolutely recommend Millennium Dog Walkers and Rebecca to friends and other pet owners.

We’ve had such an amazing experienc! They are incredibly reliable, caring, and clearly love what they do. Our dogs absolutely adore them and get so excited whenever they arrive for a walk. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing our pups are in such great hands. They always go above and beyond, and it’s obvious they truly care about the dogs they work with. We couldn’t recommend them more highly!

We absolutely love our dog walkers! Caroline and Ryan are so friendly and easy to work with, and they always send daily photos that make our day. You can tell they truly care- our dogs are always happy and excited to see them. Couldn’t recommend them more!

We’re in West Loop and couldn’t be happier with Millennium Dog Walkers. Our dog Abby is pretty anxious, but they’ve been so patient and gentle with her. The consistency and photo updates make such a difference. It’s such a relief knowing she’s in good hands every day.

This dog care service has been wonderful! They reached out right away when they went under new ownership, and are incredibly kind. They check in weekly for walks, which is great because my work schedule requires a lot of commuting and sometimes last-minute changes. Even when I need to bring my dog with me, they’re super understanding and accommodating.

I’ve had Patricia as my main dog walker, and she’s amazing. Her communication is excellent and she never forgets to send pictures and is always helpful whenever I need anything. We even came up with a system that makes it easier for everyone to access my apartment, and overall, my dog loves her.

They really make my life easier. I do the 20-walk package, which has been perfect for my schedule and my dog’s happiness. I highly recommend this team to anyone looking for reliable, caring, and professional dog care!
Super reliable, incredibly organized, and great flexibility in scheduling week to week. The dog walkers are great. My dog loves going with them!

We've been using Millenium for nearly 3 years now with our beagles. They love the gang for their daily walks and Millenium has even helped us out with house sitting when we're out of town for extended perios. Solid price, reliable service. For sure recommend!
They are a trustworthy and reliable dog walking service. They are consistently on time, professional, and our dog walker does a great job with our 7 month old golden retriever! Highly recommend!
My pups prefer their dog walkers to us I think😂 …

They took care of my puppy Leo & would highly recommend. My schedule often changed and they were very accommodating. Leo loved his main walker Patricia - we moved to another city but any time we are back we plan to book more walks! 😍🐶 Appreciate all the help! Leo misses Patricia too

Millennium Dog Walkers are the best!! I’ve been using them for almost two years and I couldn’t be happier!! Beyoncé loves her walker Patricia and just had a wonderful overnight stay with her. I felt so much better knowing she would be well taken care of!
Amazing dog walkers! Very consistent and I knew my dog was in good hands.

We’ve had such a wonderful experience with Millennium! They’re incredibly reliable, and most importantly, our dog absolutely loves his walkers—he gets visibly excited when he sees them, which hasn’t always been the case with other companies.

What really sets this business apart is the personal touch. The owner, Al, clearly cares—not just about the dogs, but about the people too. There’s no clunky app or rigid policies to navigate; it’s all refreshingly human. You can tell this is a company built on trust, care, and real relationships. We feel lucky to have found them!
We’ve been using Millennium Dog Walkers for dog walks and overnight stays for a few months now are very happy. Shout out to Angelina for taking such good care of our pup!
Al and team is amazing !

I’m so happy to have been referred to Millennium Dog Walkers! They have made my life so much easier and Teddy, my golden retriever loves his new friends. They are reliable, flexible and have even done last minute walks for me. I highly recommend them!

The only dog walking company I use! Trust worthy dog walkers. They take amazing care of my pup. I appreciate the time each walker spends with my dog. They send photos after each session including updates on how my dog did with them. Al is also very flexible and is always willing to cram in last minute walks for me. I’m truly grateful for such an amazing group.

Al Olsen has brought together a remarkable group of dog walkers. My senior dog has some special needs and the walkers treat him with patience, compassion, and such lovely care. I am so pleased to have engaged Millennium Dog Walkers to support my pup while I am at work!

I have loved my experience with Millennium Dog Walkers walking my pup!  Al and his crew are very communicative, and it's so easy to book appointments (at an affordable price). Our walker sends us a photo and synopsis of the walk immediately when they finish and so I know exactly how the walk went. Reliable and trustworthy service.
Millennium Dog Walkers its a trustworthy company, great price and amazing staff. I highly recommend!
Chris is very attentive and professional. Highly recommend!

We absolutely love Al and Millennium Dog Walkers. Our dog Stella is like family to them and they are very accommodating for scheduling and understanding of changes need to be made. We moved to Chicago mid-2024 and feel blessed that we found the best dog walker right from the beginning!  Highly recommend them!!!

Our Nebbia loves her daily walks with Shane. Her tail starts wagging the second she hears his voice. She also loves the surprise visits from Al. Highly recommend Millenium Dog Walkers if want someone that would treat your dog as you do.
Patricia has been excellent with our reactive dog, she has really been patient and taken the time for her to be comfortable. Would absolutely recommend Al’s dog walking service!

I recently moved to the area and have been blown away by the kindness and support of Al and his team. My older dog was super anxious about the move, but Al took the time to get to know him and help him feel more at ease. It’s clear that this company genuinely cares about my dog and takes a personalized approach. I highly recommend them!

Great staff and management team. Al (the founder) has been in the business for almost 15 years and has an enormous amount of experience in the field. They are well-organized and take the dog walking business very seriously. Thumbs up
Fantastic company for dog walking and cat sitting.  Highly recommend.  Al is the best!

Al and his team are the best, my doggo Hudson can't get enough of his lunchtime walks with all his walkers. I've worked directly with Al and 3 of his walkers and we have had nothing but great experiences. Highly recommend!

Attached is one of the photos that the walkers will send daily while out on walks.

The owner Al and his team time-and-again demonstrated responsive to our expectations and needs for care of our beloved ‘Auggie’. Highly recommend and at least experience what this looks like as he did for our beloved member and memories.

I would recommend Millenium Dog Walkers to anyone looking for exceptional communication and care!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
They consistently check in and send texts and pictures after walks. The walkers are kind and patient and I feel my dog is in the best hands in the city of Chicago.

Great service and professionalism. Olsen provides quick responses and it is very flexible with last minute requests. Patricia is amazing, my dog loves her. She sends updates and photos of every walk. Highly recommend this service.
I have a special need dog, and the walkers are very kind, patient and loving

Chris and Al have been nothing but wonderful to us! Goose absolutely loves Chris, and we are so lucky to have them provide walks for us when we are in the office. They are extremely easy to work with and always quick to answer any questions or schedule changes.
Angela thank you for your Review on Google, its always a pleasure for us to see Oliver and Stella.  Happy Thanksgiving.

Highly recommend Millennium Dog Walkers! Scheduling is super easy, and the team is very communicative, flexible, and dependable. We know our pup is in the best of hands, plus they’re a true joy to work with!
Great company,  I have been very happy with them for daily dog walks and overnight pet sitting. Great communication and updates.
Al provides a wonderful service and the dog walkers are all so kind and gentle with our pets! We're very glad to have this service available.
Al and his team of dog walkers are great! Al is very reliable, and the walkers are extremely kind, caring, and reliable. I am very protective over my dog and trust this company!

Been working with Al and his team for at least 3 months and they are awesome!  they are dependable and all the people that have walked my little boi are amazing with him.  I would highly recommend Al and his team for taking care of your doggies.  <3

Great owner and great dog walking service based out of Streeterville. Affordable pricing and very flexible with our schedules as healthcare providers. Patricia is an awesome walker and our dog Poppy loves her! You get photos and text updates after each walk. Highly recommend.
Wonderful people! Reliable, easy to schedule, and really care about our puppy. Highly recommend!
Very reliable and my dog loves her walkers! They send a photo of my dog during her walk which is reassuring that she is well taken care of.

I've had an amazing experience with Millennium Dog Walkers! The owner is incredibly communicative and kind, I love having the flexibility each week to decide what days I need walks because of travel. I've also absolutely loved our walker Patricia. My dog is quite shy and she was so caring, thoughtful, helpful, and sweet with her! My dog adores her and gets so excited to see her on the out in public as well. She seriously made all the difference for our experience! My only complaint is that I'm moving to a new part of town and won't be able to get walks through Millennium anymore. I'm hoping that changes in the future because I've really loved using this service!
Great service from Al and love the dog walkers!  Highly recommended!

We love Millennium Dog Walkers! They’re professional, reliable and we know we can trust them fully with our dogs! Shane walks our dogs 3x a week and is always on time and gives us an update on the dogs after. We’re so lucky we found them!
